# DiffSynth-Studio runtime snapshot

Source: https://github.com/modelscope/DiffSynth-Studio

Commit: `4e3496991455b300fd60ab023113422cd16899f5`

This directory vendors the unmodified `diffsynth/` runtime, its Apache-2.0
license and package metadata. Upstream examples, assets, tests and Git metadata
are omitted. Framework model adaptations live in `models/`; historical experiment adapters remain in their original packages.
No separate clone or submodule initialization is needed.
